description: The report presents measurements from core-network and end-to-end tests at the Athens, Berlin, Malaga and Oulu platforms through August 2024. LoadCore and IxChariot support the tests, and reference trial networks permit comparisons within and between platforms. The source identifies a noticeable performance difference between platforms and states that hardware and virtualization specifications need more precise definition. This makes the report a documented benchmarking and calibration information source. The deposit contains a PDF, not a verified raw results table. Test-count totals, metric values and independence of repeated experiments remain unknown in the inspected metadata. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. The deposited documents or data declare CC BY 4.0 and public access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain bounded to explicitly named tests or locations, with other fields unknown. Only metadata was inspected, without reading measurements, archives, source code or document bodies. Related project reports may overlap; independent sample counts and equivalent test conditions are not assumed. This supports the source-defined communication system performance simulation role.
